conclusion: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the requirement for transparent, orthogonal EV characterization, production reporting, and validated assays prior to advancing cross-lot or cross-species intact-EV bridging studies. However, assertions that program-specific artifacts (MCB/WCB records, validated intact‑EV assays, GMP-like batch release/stability/potency data, and intact‑EV cross‑species biodistribution/orthogonal assay datasets) are absent are unsupported by the supplied evidence because no program-level documentation was provided in the cited evidence.
unsupported_assertions: No program-specific CMC documents (MCB/WCB creation, assay validation reports, GMP-like batch release and stability data) were provided to demonstrate compliance with MISEV recommendations.
Absence of batch-run comparability data, scale-up validation/engineering reports, and MCB/WCB establishment details for SGL-001.
Program-level intact-EV-specific biodistribution data, orthogonal assay outputs distinguishing vesicular from non-vesicular signal, and cross-species bridging controls are missing.

The specific Stage-1 items (produce/qualify MCB/WCB, complete fit-for-purpose validation of intact-EV assays with LLOQ/specificity/precision, stability-indicating potency assay correlated to in vivo PD, reproducible release/stability/potency across ≥3 GMP-like batches, formulation/device compatibility demonstrated ex vivo/in vivo) are documented as incomplete for SGL-001.
